author: minertedtoad
body:
Hi,

Recently I have noticed that staff have payed no attention to any thing I say and I have made my decision to leave the server. I have been playing on this server since 2014 and in that time have made loads of friends but the staff have just been so disrespectful. This is one of the least likely decisions i have made but I feel like it is for the good. I would like to say good bye to all the people who have made this experience truly memorable:

Lokigh
Kojasprite
Xtramajestical
EDJM9
InputIGNHere
JapaneseSquid
Ephsians
LFT
Alexanderjoe
paulinaOwO
Yenry
Micquisha
Clijmart
Boldandbrash
resepignev
Ciyh
Ciaan
Imryaan

All of the above people are what made the avicus server special and were true friends. I will now go on moderating on my own server. I will come on once a month to see you guys but apart from that see you in the future.


Finale Regards

Edward
